purpose: Separate exact-acceleration candidate replacing repeated set construction/subset checks with integer bitmask subset checks over a frozen macro-atom universe.
exactness_contract: Macro-atom universe is frozen before search by collecting compiler primitive IDs and their executable lineages.
Set inclusion A subseteq B is represented by (mask(A) & mask(B)) == mask(A).
Decision trace decodes masks back to the sorted string identifiers, so an equality comparison against the E trace compares actual lineage attributes as well as decisions.
No candidate generation, expression canonicalization, rank, dominance ordering, retained frontier, or scientific gate is intentionally changed.
An atom outside the frozen universe raises an explicit error; no silent truncation or dynamically renumbered IDs are permitted.
validation_required: E-versus-F decision_trace_sha256 equality at all shared completed-comparison checkpoints.
All logical counters and checkpoint identities match; implementation-specific work counters are reported separately.
Then run a larger deterministic fixed-work prefix and report throughput and peak memory.
